description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -30% (15s)]/[ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (15s)] if 1/2+ FF5 allies are alive, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 2/4+ FF5 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Thief] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user
